implementation_summary: stage-models-api.ts: loadModels/saveModels for GET/PUT /api/audit-ai/models; replies checked and unknown stages dropped; refusals become plain sentences (ERR_FORBIDDEN: owner-only text); a 400 keeps its per-field messages from errors or fields (stored with defineProperty so a __proto__ key stays a plain field); modelsUpdate sends only changed stages, trimmed, with null for a cleared field; defaultModel picks the text or vision default by slot; afterSave keeps the reply and the typed fields on a refusal and takes the new reply on success. AuditAiModelsPanel.tsx: stateless AuditAiModelsView plus the stateful AuditAiModelsPanel (loading, load failure, saving, discard). Four labelled inputs in AUDIT_AI_STAGES order, with aria-describedby pointing to the hint, the default line and the error; aria-invalid on refused fields; each shows 'Default when empty: X. In use now: Y.' from the reply; a body-level message is shown with the Save button. The packet asked for types from @qa/types/src/ai.js, but the T-211 guard (packages/types/tests/browser-entry.test.ts) fails any wizard import of @qa/types/src/ other than browser.js, and ai.ts is not re-exported from browser.ts. So the stages, shapes, route and default slots are copied locally, and a test compares them with ai.ts read from disk.
